## Community Spotlight: Hospice of the Piedmont


Virginia National Bank is proud to support **[Hospice of the Piedmont](https://hopva.org/)** (HOPVA), the only local nonprofit hospice in our area. Understanding HOPVA's programs and services that are available to members of our community is something Jenn Downs, Vice President of Business Strategy and Marketing, discusses with Sherry Taylor of VNB.


The mission of Hospice of the Piedmont is, "To guide life's final journey with expertise and empathy." The staff and volunteers at HOPVA work hard each day to assist their clients and family members with "above and beyond care" and support.


View our new commercial featuring Hospice of the Piedmont created in partnership with CBS19 News and cinematographer Alex De Montbel **[here](https://youtu.be/on3_6Cw7PJM?si=GY8jJLk5CTqZyU9n)** .


In our new podcast episode, Jenn Downs explains how Hospice of the Piedmont helps support families before, during, and after the passing of a loved one.
